sources.supporting_excerpt: The MTP Module is an ultra-lightweight fixed-step autoregressive dense transformer, with low memory bandwidth requirements on inference hardware, thereby naturally enabling efficient batch processing of high throughput requests.
sources.inspection: Read both sections, including multi-turn textual/multimodal conditioning; zeroth codebook then all residual codebooks; current-frame completion then left-context codec decoding. Fixed-step autoregressive refers to codebook sequence, not independent parallel future-word heads. Did not use reported latency table as evidence for this CPU toy.
